system.description:
Range 30ft; 1 round per level (concentration). Draw up to 1d4 shadowy creatures from the dark. Each uses the stats of a creature of Level 3 or lower you choose, acts on your turn, and deals half damage. A creature that studies or fights one makes a Will save; success sees through it and takes no damage from it. A shadow vanishes at 0 HP.

Classes: Wizard, Illusionist, Bard, Necromancer
system.saveEffect: Sees through it and takes no damage from it
